description: From the fz-6fr investigation (2026-07-15): Maps {:halted, acc}/{:suspended, ...} clauses fall OUTSIDE the k22.8 trivial_value_clause_ids gate (they carry steps, non-bare-Value tails), so the demand passes still do not walk them while codegen lowers all clauses. A widening was DRAFTED and proven unrelated to the fz-6fr crashes (reverting it left both fixes intact) so it was correctly not committed. This is a latent instance of the same demand<->codegen contract class -- no concrete crash reproduces it today. If a materialize-absent crash ever surfaces with a Tuple/Const-returning pruned clause in the trace, this is the first place to look. Verification approach exists in the fz-6fr agent transcript.
title: k22.8 trivial-clause widening gate excludes Tuple/Const-only clauses (steps present) -- latent demand-starvation gap, no concrete crash yet
